data.name: Gwen
data.description:
Gwendolyn Maxine "Gwen" Stacy was born in the 2000s in the Chelsea borough of New York City. She was born as the only daughter of police officer George Stacy and his wife Helen Stacy. Helen died early on in Gwen's childhood, resulting in George having to raise her on his own and Gwen not getting to know her mother well, if at all. George's career as a police officer would inspire Gwen to live to uphold the law and help others. George was close friends with the Parker family who were their neighbour's. Gwen met and befriended Peter Parker in her childhood, forming a close bond with him throughout the years and grew to consider him her only friend.[2]

In her teenage years, Gwen was enrolled by her father at Visions Academy. alongside Peter. At Visions, she met and befriended Mary Jane, Betty Brant and Glory Grant, and joined their punk rock band "The Mary Janes" as their drummer. Gwen became interested and in ballet, and also joined the school gymnastics team. Her father supported her in these activities. Unfortunately, Peter did not have the same luck as Gwen and became isolated due to his "nerdy" appearance and interests. This caused Peter to become an easy target for bullying from other students, especially Ned Leeds. Gwen would often stand up for Peter but instead of helping the bullying to stop, it only caused it to increase as it made Peter look weak in front of others, unknowingly furthering his humiliation and fuelling his sense of worthlessness and despair.

As a member of the Spider-Society, Gwen would be unofficially mentored by Jessica Drew. She would grow to gain a large respect for the woman and would look up to her for guidance as the mother figure she never had in her life. During one of her many missions, she would meet Hobie Brown and become close friends with him. Hobie would often let the now homeless Gwen stay in his universe, and join his band. She would also meet Pavitr Prabhakar, who's also a member of the Spider Society. During one of her missions with Hobie, they would capture a variant of the Prowler as well as do a mission in a Shakespeare dimension.[2]

Gwen would reunite with Peter B. Parker and Peni Parker, however, they were all prohibited from ever reaching out to Miles as they were told he was an "anomaly" and that he was dangerous to the stability of the multiverse. She would also learn the truth about what usually happens to Gwen Stacy if she falls in love with Spider-Man and it not ending well. Despite the society trying to insist on her avoiding Miles, Gwen would try to remember her best friend and maintained the impromptu haircut he had given her, dying the ends of it pink and letting it grow longer.

Gwen would make some changes to her suit during her time in the Spider-Society, adding long pink fingerless gloves with blue web patterns that go up to her elbows, and blue Chucks that she took from Hobie, replacing her blue pointe shoes.[2]
